input_kind: Synthetic ramps, fixed-seed arrays, flat fields and bright rectangles; no photographs
scope: Native kernel output only. Does not validate complete X3F rendering, calibration, camera support, UI or export.
notes: PyramidFilter supplies temporary rows immediately after each half-size level. The recovered implementation models these rows explicitly inside its own allocated arrays.

Standalone SmoothDoubleBlend comparisons use odd output heights; external bytes following a standalone input can affect the native even-height last row. The recovered implementation always uses its own defined working-row state.
The log luminance recenter mean is measured before filtering. The final global scale is measured after converting filtered variance through the local standard-deviation table.
Nonzero native gain LUT leaves signed index -32768 untouched. The public recovered entry point rejects that index.
